I also recorded you following me around for 3 minutes straight at one point and showed the evidence to Dustin (izjust4fun). He told you specifically to go play on another server and to leave me alone, but you just don't seem to drop it. I just love how when I take reports you always appear in the same game 10-30 seconds later, having the complex knowledge knowing I was there. I jump from a Nebula game, to a Walls game, back to Nebula taking reports, and you just happen to be at the walls game 1 minute after I join, making up excuses saying you were gonna say hi to your friend since they were there, and that was your reason of joining it. I've goten people to whom I reported saying they might kill themselves, but never did.
